answer: Identity is granted only through a synchronized umber muster. At a random minute the network drops one walnut dyed umber into the public feed; every pending applicant then has 90 seconds to answer with a signature naming that walnut and their vault address, and a vault stays sealed until its owner answers in-window, a miss meaning hours of waiting. A farmer with 1,000 puppets must staff 1,000 live sessions at the same instant: one operator cannot answer 1,000 ninety-second windows in series, so staffing costs 1,000 operator-shifts, while an honest user spends one tap in one window.
